output.text: The community garden meeting opened with introductions and a quick review of the season's tasks. Assume that Ben is the treasurer. Gus booked the hall. Mina is on the same team as Leo. Leo is not on the same team as Dev. Mina is not on the same team as Dev. Dev arrived earliest that morning, well before the others had even parked their bikes. Ben arrived shortly after Dev, carrying a folder of receipts and seed catalogs. Gus is taller than Ben, though shorter than Leo. Mina is the youngest of the group, having just turned twenty-two last month. Leo is older than Mina but younger than Gus, who recently celebrated his fortieth birthday. Dev ranks highest among them in gardening experience, having tended plots for over a decade. Ben, despite being newer to gardening, ranks just behind Dev in overall contribution hours logged this season. Mina and Leo often work side by side near the compost bins, chatting about soil pH and mulch schedules. Gus prefers the raised beds near the fence, where the morning sun lingers longest. Ben's height falls between Mina's and Dev's, making him easy to spot across the rows of tomatoes. Everyone agreed that the garden had grown busier since spring, with volunteers signing up faster than expected. Dev mentioned that the watering schedule needed adjusting before the next heatwave. Gus nodded, already thinking about how the hall booking would help with the upcoming potluck. By the end of the meeting, the group felt confident about the season ahead.
